_meta.description: SEED golden dataset for retrieval + generation evals. This is scaffolding, NOT a production golden set. Per llm-evals-standards a real golden set is 50-200 hand-verified Q/A+citation pairs drawn from ACTUAL usage. Grow this from real production failures: every wrong answer or bad citation becomes a permanent case here so the system can never regress on the same bug twice.
_meta.fictional_business: Acme Cloud Storage — a fictional SaaS whose docs cover pricing, security, and account management. Used only so the seed rows are concrete; replace with your tenant's real docs.
_meta.schema: list of {question, expected_answer, expected_doc_ids}. expected_doc_ids are the document UUIDs/ids that MUST appear among retrieved citations for the answer to be considered grounded.

cases.question: What is the maximum file size I can upload on the free plan?
cases.expected_answer: On the free plan the maximum single-file upload size is 2 GB.

cases.question: How much storage does the Pro plan include?
cases.expected_answer: The Pro plan includes 1 TB of storage.

cases.question: Is data encrypted at rest?
cases.expected_answer: Yes. All stored data is encrypted at rest using AES-256.

cases.question: Does Acme support single sign-on?
cases.expected_answer: Yes, SSO via SAML 2.0 is available on the Business and Enterprise plans.

cases.question: How do I reset my account password?
cases.expected_answer: Use the 'Forgot password' link on the sign-in page; a reset link is emailed to your registered address and expires after 30 minutes.

cases.question: How long are deleted files retained before permanent deletion?
cases.expected_answer: Deleted files are kept in the trash for 30 days before they are permanently removed.

cases.question: Can I get a refund if I cancel mid-billing-cycle?
cases.expected_answer: Cancellations take effect at the end of the current billing period; Acme does not issue prorated refunds for partial periods.

cases.question: Which regions can I choose to store my data in?
cases.expected_answer: Data residency can be set to the US, EU, or APAC regions on Business and Enterprise plans.
